strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
Kosuke! You sure this is the place!?
No doubt about it, Hyoma.
According to the heat-tracking camera, Garuda fled in here!
Hyoma, ya don't need to check! It's obviously fishy!
Sure is a creepy place. A base like this under a dormant volcano...
No wonder Londo Bell couldn't track
the Campbellians' movements.
...Who'd have thought they already had a base on Earth...
Combattler V...
You've done well to come this far. But this is where you end...!
The stone statue!?
What the!? That thing can talk!?
What the hell are you!?
I am Oleana... leader of the Campbellian Earth conquest army...!
I get it! You're the boss!
Get ready! Combattler V is gonna
smash your ambitions to pieces!
Lady Oleana! When I defeat Combattler V...!
I will keep my promise, Mia... if you can defeat it, that is.
Yes, my lady! ...Lord Garuda... I, Mia, will surely defeat Combattler V...!
Kukuku... Splendid... splendid, Combattler V... Gandor Team...!
Answer me, Garuda! What's the connection between you Campbellians
and those Einst!?
The connection with the Campbellians...? Heh heh...
You ask that of me, a robot who isn't even Campbellian, Hyoma Aoi!?
Very well... Thousands of years ago, Mother descended to this Earth.
Humans had nothing yet that could be called science or technology.
Why did Mother not conquer the Earth then...
No, why could she not conquer it...
Couldn't... conquer it?
Meaning they did try to conquer it...?
Hey, what's that supposed to mean, Garuda!?
...Combattler V, Gandor Team.
This battle... was one I do not regret...
What're ya sayin'!? What happens next, then!?
Daisaku! He's... already...
Mia... I will never let you go again... never...
So this is it! To think they were hiding in a new volcano on a remote island!
Doctor! It's the Combattler team!
That's... the Gandor Team's here!
Commander Hazuki!
All right, support Combattler and wipe out the enemy!
All units, launch!!
All riiight! Campbellians! Time to pay up...!
Who'd have thought they had a base on Earth!
So they already had a forward base. But... it ends here!
Let's finish them in one go, Tetsuya!
The Campbellian base, huh... Crush it, and that's one less enemy.
Building a base in a place like this without asking...
No, this has likely been their base since ancient times...
Exactly.
I have been in this land since before you humans were born...
How old are you, anyway?
That's not the point!
Bold, flying your battleship in. I'll finish you in one blow...!
Try it if you can...! But first, I'll pound some steel into you.
Easy, Nanbu. Their home base won't be this lightly guarded...
That's exactly why we need to act calmly.
How can I stay calm with the enemy boss right in front of me!? Here I go!
Big Bro! Captain Amuro's obviously right!
Let it go, Mike. He never listens anyway.
...I'll back him up properly.
Mmph!
It's the Einst!
Where'd they just come from!?
Oh... you lend me your aid... As I thought, the Earthlings...
The Earthlings...? Hey, Mari, did you catch the rest of that!?
Sorry, Mister. The explosions were too loud...
Of course Akira's not around at a time like this!
...Raideen might've been able to figure something out!
Hm? Hey, something's wrong with the little one.
Cham, what's wrong? Cham!?
That enemy... we shouldn't provoke it too much...
Why not, Cham?
I dunno...
Cham senses something too...
Do you sense something too, Asuka?
Same as Cham... All I can say is it feels bad.
(That enemy... a voice only I can hear...)
...Not... de... sired...
Some connection to the Campbellians...!?
Man... I can feel this crazy pressure...
But hey! We can't back down either!
That's right, we've got to... push forward!
Claws that can tear Super Alloy New Z...! But I won't retreat here!
Exactly...!
One by one! It's the Campbell base... we can't miss this chance!
So this is the end of the Campbellians... right?
Not yet... Garuda's still left.
Come to think of it, I don't see him.
Don't tell me he chickened out and ran?
...He'd never do something like that.
...Come out, Garuda! Let's settle this...!
Not bad... Garuda!
Isn't Garuda acting strange...?
...Forgive me... Mia. I... didn't know.
That I was a robot, just like Mia... If only I'd known a little sooner...
Mia, I could have accepted your feelings...
Say what!? Garuda's a robot!?
But it's too late now... Everything is far too late...!
Wh-What's gotten into Garuda!?
Fight me, Combattler V! And you humans of the Gandor Team!
This is my... my own battle, for myself...!
A robot... that was given feelings...
Silence! Here I come...!
Hyoma! Here he comes!
Garuda, I don't know who you are or what happened to you.
But we can't afford to lose to you either...!
Well said...! And I don't intend to accept any mercy from you!
...Great General Garuda, huh.
So we never found out what links the Campbellians to the Einst...
I just can't see what they're after...
Cham? How are you? Feeling calmer?
...Yeah, but... if we keep fighting like this...
Cham, be more specific. What exactly is so bad?
I told you! I don't know! But bad is bad!
Right? If that thing keeps showing up...
No no no no nooo!
Goals and identity unknown... all we know is they're the enemy.
That's right. But...
If what that Great General said is true...
then the Campbellians were on Earth thousands of years ago.
What happened back then...
Yeah. Back then, nobody could've stood up to the Campbellians.
It's weird.
Now, of all times, when the Earth Sphere is in this much chaos,
they decide to start an invasion? That's strange.
Way too much competition.
Even if they're exploiting the chaos, with this many armies on the move,
I don't get why they'd bother sticking their noses in.
Right. Why do all these armies...
have to move at almost the same time?
I get what you two are saying. But...
Mm... this is no time for debate.
I think we can say the fight with the Campbellians is settled for now.
However, whatever comes of the colony problem,
we still have work to do.
Quite right. Commander Hazuki, let's move out.
All right, all units, return!
Gandor heads to the next point while we repair and resupply!
Hyoma?
So long, Garuda.
